name: Figma
subhead: Plugins that keep your design system in step.
intro: Focused plugins that take the repetitive work out of Figma, so files stay tidy and teams stay in sync.

install.title: Find it in Figma Community.
install.text: Search for the plugin by name, or use the Get button on its page here.

install.title: Save it to your account.
install.text: Saved plugins are available in every file you open.

install.title: Run it from the Plugins menu.
install.text: In any file, open Plugins and pick it from your saved plugins.

subhead: Layout automation for documents that run to hundreds of pages.
